locatorProfile.dominantStrategy: aria-label / role+name (no data-testid anywhere in this component tree); row containers themselves have no aria-label, only nested action buttons do — use getByRole('button', { name: /ServerName/ }) matching the composite accessible name for row-level clicks

keyFindings: Page loaded correctly, already authenticated, no login wall encountered.
4 connectors present: Market Leads + Mira Voice (Connected, both immutable native presets with Disconnect permanently disabled), Outlook + Gmail (Not Connected, Connect enabled).
Detail view (drill-down) works for immutable presets: shows full 8-tool list with all switches checked and enabled, no Connect/Disconnect button rendered in header at all (by design).

Connect entry point (Outlook) verified functional end-to-end up to the OAuth handoff: POST /authorize succeeded (200), a real Microsoft OAuth consent popup opened as a separate page (login.microsoftonline.com, via backend.composio.dev redirect). Did NOT complete the OAuth flow per instructions — popup was closed and main page reloaded to reset pending spinner state.

NOTE for downstream test generation (not a bug): this QA workspace's local messages/en.json is missing the entire settings.connectors i18n dictionary (only a bare 'connectors' nav label exists). Real keys live in the Mira repo at apps/mira-work/i18n/messages/en/agent.json (settings.connectors namespace, lines ~690-720). Spec/POM generators must pull i18n text from there, not from this project's local messages dir, per e2e-flakiness-playbook.md §2.

No data-testid attributes exist anywhere in this component tree; locators must rely on aria-label (present on Back button, section triggers, and Connect/Disconnect action buttons) or composite accessible name matching for the clickable row containers themselves (which have no aria-label).
